extraction.note: Canva export: each page is a flattened image; the deck was read visually and the brand facts recorded as explicit brief facts

brand.name: Off Hours
brand.category: D2C sleep & recovery - functional night-drink sachets (melatonin-free)
brand.product: 10-sachet box of a magnesium + L-theanine + chamomile night drink; subscription refill
brand.geography: Mumbai + Bengaluru, India - two-city beachhead; delivery via own storefront
price: 1,899/mo subscription refill (competes with one dinner out)
brand.business_goal: 1,000 paying subscribed households within the first 12 months across Mumbai + Bengaluru
brand.strategic_stance: We compete with the habit of not switching off, not with pharmacies.
competitive_set: OTC sleep gummies and melatonin tablets

persona.name: Meera Nair
persona.quote: I don't have a sleep problem - I have a switching-off problem. Show me something simple that actually works and I'll stick with it.
persona.day: Stand-ups at 10 am, deep work at night. Gym membership renewed yearly, used rarely. Orders in 4-5 nights a week. Unwinds with series + scrolls till 1 am. Alarm at 7:30.
goals: Wake up clear-headed without another pill
Feel in control of her evenings again
pain_points: Sceptical of gummies after one bad experience
motivations: A ritual that feels like hers
persona.buying_behaviour: Trials first; checks ingredients + reviews; pays UPI; will subscribe after one good full box; cancels in one click if annoyed.
persona.demographics: 25-40, single or young-couple households; degree-educated professionals in tech, finance, consulting, media; 12L+ annual household income; Mumbai (Powai, Lower Parel, Andheri) and Bengaluru (Indiranagar, Koramangala, HSR)
psychographics: Evidence-seeking wellness sceptics - read ingredient lists, dislike hype, want better mornings more than 'sleep'
Digital-native shoppers - buy online several times a week, subscribe and cancel ruthlessly, discover via short video and peer group chats, research reviews before any ingested product
Active 10 pm-1 am - the exact window the brand is designed to interrupt and serve
not_our_audience: Anyone outside Mumbai + Bengaluru in phase 1

objectives_smart.name: Acquire - Trial & Conversion
objectives_smart.owner: top of funnel and the first conversion gate
targets: >=12% of trialists converted to subscription within 30 days of trial start

objectives_smart.name: Retain - Revenue Quality
objectives_smart.owner: the compounding engine that makes the 1,000-household base durable
targets: 60% of monthly revenue from existing subscribers by month 12

strategy.broad_approach: rest-and-consolidation first: everything digital exists to convert a trial into a calm, repeatable evening habit and then into a subscription - not to chase reach
loop: Earn First Attention - short-video and search content earn honest attention and answer the ingredient questions that build trust
Convert at Low Friction - the storefront converts with a low-friction 999 trial, no commitment, no risk
Own the Relationship - pack insert, WhatsApp refill concierge and the fortnightly sleep-journal letter carry the relationship through the 10-day judgement window and into subscription
Paid Amplifies, Never Leads - paid spend re-finds people already in the loop; it follows proven messages, never precedes them
strategy.phase_1_launch: Short-video, search, storefront, owned channels. Build the trial-to-subscription loop. Prove the retention engine.
strategy.phase_2_partnerships: Brand partnerships - company wellness programmes, clinics - arrive once the subscriber base makes Off Hours worth partnering with.

peso.Paid: Retargeting to site visitors and video viewers; later, sponsored discovery inside quick-commerce listings once demand exists. Primary job: re-find warm audiences; amplify proven messages only.
peso.Earned: Wellness editors and newsletters covering the switch-off culture; the brand's founding narrative - built melatonin-free for India's late-working cities. Primary job: third-party credibility the ingredient-sceptic trusts.
peso.Shared: Customers posting their night-routine rituals; 10-night challenge check-ins; referral links in group chats. Primary job: turns the ritual into social proof; peer recommendation.
peso.Owned: Storefront and product pages, WhatsApp refill concierge (opt-in), sleep-journal email letter, pack inserts. Primary job: the retention spine - where trials become subscribers.

channels_5_priorities.why: Where our audience actually unwinds at 10 pm; ritual content formats natively.
Ingredient questions are the trust gate; the brand must answer them itself.
Low-friction 999 trial; owns the data the subscription model needs.
User-consented, India-native, high-open - perfect for refill timing and questions.
The 10-day judgement window needs a guide; letters out-sell loud campaigns.

named_non_priorities.why: Wrong age and wrong moment - unmeasurable against our conversion objectives.
Spend ahead of demand - awareness money lands before trial intent exists.
Borrowed attention, wrong trust mechanic for an ingested product.
A listing helps logistics, but we refuse to rent the brand's first impression.

journey.referral_loop: subscribers who share referral links in group chats re-enter the loop at discovery

four_decisions: We Compete With the Habit of Not Switching Off
Partnerships and Mass Awareness Are Deliberately Delayed
